keyFindings.finding: Agent cost overruns are driven by autonomy without constraint — agents pursue goals until a human stops them or the credit card declines.
LLM inference accounts for 60-80% of total AI agent costs; token waste (not model choice) is the primary cost driver.
Most teams see 30-50% cost reduction after a first optimization pass (prompt compression, caching). A second round (model routing + caching) can reach 60-70% savings.
Four components of agent budget framework: (1) payment identity per agent, (2) hard spending caps, (3) per-agent cost visibility, (4) instant revocation.
57% of organizations have no formal AI-agent governance controls today; only 26% are very confident they could prove AI agent involvement in an incident.
Policy as Code (PaC) is emerging as the recommended approach to embed compliance and budget rules directly into agent workflows.
Open-source tools (agentbudget, agent-cost-guardrails, agent-budget-guard) now provide drop-in Python libraries for hard budget enforcement with circuit breakers.
